prompt.alinti: This free AI tool lets you scrape unlimited local leads without having to pay for anything.
It's called Google Maps Scraper Kit, and it's a free and open source scraper that just runs on your own computer, with Claude automating the entire scraping process for you.
You just tell it the city and the type of business you want to target, and it'll come back with a clean list of everyone, including their name, phone number, email, website, and even address.
Plus it even pulls their social media accounts straight from their website, so you guys can reach them there too.
If you want to try this for yourself, just comment 'Google' down below, and I'll send you guys the repo.
